final: WITH j AS (SELECT p.fundflux AS fundflux, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM scanspatial s JOIN projects p ON s.arcref = p.arcregistry GROUP BY p.fundflux), t AS (SELECT SUM(cnt) AS total, AVG(cnt * 1.0) AS avg_cnt FROM j) SELECT j.fundflux, j.cnt AS spatial_count, j.cnt * 1.0 / t.total AS share, j.cnt - t.avg_cnt AS excess_over_avg FROM j, t WHERE j.cnt > t.avg_cnt ORDER BY j.cnt DESC
